commands.command: CONFIG_PATH=config.yaml .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_external_data.py tests/test_candidate.py tests/test_two_tower.py tests/test_deepfm.py tests/test_reranking.py

.venv/bin/python -c 'import json
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
from src.common.artifacts import file_hash, fingerprint, write_json
from src.external_data.hm_revisit import configuration, dependencies
from src.recommendation.datasets import read_data
from src.recommendation.train_two_tower import load_bundle
spec=yaml.safe_load(Path('"'"'config/external_hm_v2.yaml'"'"').read_text())
root=Path(spec['"'"'results_dir'"'"'])
choice=json.loads((root/'"'"'selection.json'"'"').read_text())
assert choice['"'"'spec_fingerprint'"'"']==fingerprint(spec)
assert choice['"'"'dependencies'"'"']==dependencies(spec)
assert all(file_hash(Path(p))==h for p,h in choice['"'"'source_hashes'"'"'].items())
cfg=configuration(spec)
data=read_data(cfg['"'"'paths'"'"']['"'"'data_dir'"'"'],'"'"'test'"'"')
_,_,_,meta=load_bundle(Path(spec['"'"'work_dir'"'"'])/'"'"'models/two_tower'"'"',data,cfg)
assert data['"'"'manifest'"'"']['"'"'generation_fingerprint'"'"']==choice['"'"'data_fingerprint'"'"']
for split in ['"'"'valid'"'"','"'"'test'"'"']:
    report=json.loads((root/f'"'"'{split}.json'"'"').read_text())
    assert report['"'"'dependencies'"'"']==choice['"'"'dependencies'"'"']
    assert report['"'"'data_fingerprint'"'"']==choice['"'"'data_fingerprint'"'"']
    assert report['"'"'chosen'"'"']=={k:choice[k] for k in ['"'"'window_days'"'"','"'"'neural_weight'"'"','"'"'deepfm_weight'"'"']}
    assert report['"'"'hybrid'"'"']['"'"'candidate'"'"']['"'"'candidate_count_min'"'"']==300
    assert report['"'"'hybrid'"'"']['"'"'candidate'"'"']['"'"'candidate_count_max'"'"']==300
    assert report['"'"'status'"'"']=='"'"'PASS'"'"' and report['"'"'acceptance'"'"']=='"'"'UNMEASURED'"'"'
training=json.loads((root/'"'"'candidate_training.json'"'"').read_text())
assert training['"'"'best_epoch'"'"']==meta['"'"'best_epoch'"'"']
assert meta['"'"'hashes'"'"']['"'"'two_tower.pt'"'"']==file_hash(Path(spec['"'"'work_dir'"'"'])/'"'"'models/two_tower/two_tower.pt'"'"')
old=json.loads(Path('"'"'docs/results/experiments/A/workflow_before_hm_v2_20261114.json'"'"').read_text())
preserved={p:h for p,h in old['"'"'source_hashes'"'"'].items() if p.startswith('"'"'docs/results/external/v1/'"'"')}
assert preserved and all(file_hash(Path(p))==h for p,h in preserved.items())
assert '"'"'50 passed'"'"' in (root/'"'"'regression.txt'"'"').read_text()
write_json(root/'"'"'verification.json'"'"',dict(status='"'"'PASS'"'"',acceptance='"'"'UNMEASURED'"'"',
    data_fingerprint=choice['"'"'data_fingerprint'"'"'], config_fingerprint=fingerprint(spec),
    source_hashes=choice['"'"'source_hashes'"'"'], preserved_v1_reports=preserved,
    dependencies=choice['"'"'dependencies'"'"'],
    report_hashes={str(p):file_hash(p) for p in sorted(root.iterdir()) if p.is_file() and p.name!='"'"'verification.json'"'"'},
    test_scope='"'"'previously inspected v1 test, valid-selected exploratory follow-up'"'"',
    unmeasured=['"'"'untouched new holdout'"'"','"'"'all-customer neural training'"'"','"'"'H&M image embeddings'"'"','"'"'serving latency and online A/B'"'"']))
print('"'"'PASS: frozen selection, data, model and source hashes; original v1 reports preserved'"'"')
'
